'''Pummels''', or '''energy pummels''', as many soldiers dubbed them, were large tank-like siege engines in use by many organizations, civilizations, and factions from the time before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref><ref name="Clone Campaigns">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>

[[File:ImperialPummel.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Imperial pummels]]
Pummels utilized powerful short-range [[Laser/Legends|laser]] panel arrays to grind down enemy defensive fortifications, including walls, antipersonnel turrets, and even localized ground-based [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], allowing lighter units and infantry to breach strong points and engage entrenched enemy forces. Though heavily armored, pummels were also very slow and vulnerable to land and air-based attacks; to compensate for this, pummels were often sent into battle either heavily escorted, or once the enemy's mobile opposition had been dealt with and/or distracted.<ref name="Battlegrounds" /><ref name="Clone Campaigns" /><ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

There were two types of energy pummel; a standard version, and a heavy version which was larger, sported thicker armor and inflicted greater damage due to the addition of more and/or larger laser panels.<ref name="Battlegrounds" /><ref name="Clone Campaigns" />

[[File:WookieePummel.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Wookiee pummels]]
Functionally speaking, there was little difference between the various pummels used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], and [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] beyond their appearance, and the same held true for their heavier counterparts. The only exceptions to this were the pummels donated to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] by the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], which had their speed increased by Geonosian engineers.<ref name="Clone Campaigns" /><ref>The [https://swgb.fandom.com/wiki/Geonosian_Engineers Geonosian Engineers] technology increases the movement speed of all heavy weapons by 10% and their reload speed by 1/4 second, though pummels don't benefit from the latter bonus.</ref>

The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] used a living creature known as a [[Cerrabore]] in the same role as a pummel, with larger specimens serving as the equivalent to a heavy pummel.<ref name="Battlegrounds" />

They were very similar to the [[Destroyer (Galactic Empire)|aquatic destroyers]] seen on the water, which used similar laser panels to literally dissolve enemy ships at a very close range.<ref name="Battlegrounds" /><ref name="Clone Campaigns" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CorporateAllianceEnergyPummel-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|213x213px|Concept art of a Corporate Alliance Energy Pummel.]]
Pummels appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', as well as its [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. The ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' uses a picture of the Wookiee Energy Pummel as an example of this type of unit.
